newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Oct 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Oct 2.

text.p: These are significant stories in the Ivorian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy. FRATERNITE MATIN - Prime Minister Daniel Kablan Duncan, on investment drive in North America, urges Texas business to invest in Ivory Coast. - Duncan, in interview with U.S. television network CBS, says "Ivory Coast today is perhaps considered as the lighthouse of West Africa and a very important country in Africa". - Debt-ridden state carrier Air Ivoire needs a thourough overhaul of its organisation in order to assure its place as a national and regional transporter -- first of two-part special report on the airline. LA VOIE - Reduction of Ivory Coast's debt under latest debt relief measures a welcome move but raises question of management of credits accorded to the country. LE JOUR - Start of school year on Tuesday marked by confusion: teachers, students and parents not ready. -- Abidjan newsroom +225 21 90 90
